searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: App Store search queries (e.g. Slack, photo editor, mindfulness).

apps.title: App IDs or App Store URLs
apps.description: Numeric iTunes track IDs or full App Store links such as https://apps.apple.com/us/app/slack/id618783545.

chartTypes.title: Charts
chartTypes.description: Official iTunes RSS charts to include, in addition to search and lookups.

country.title: Country
country.description: App Store country code (us, gb, de, fr, jp, br, in, au, ca, …).

entity.title: Search entity
entity.description: What the keyword search should return. Charts have their own iPhone / iPad / Mac feed types.

genre.title: Chart genre (optional)
genre.description: Filter charts by genre name or Apple genre ID (e.g. Games or 6014, Finance, Social Networking).

includeReviews.title: Include customer reviews
includeReviews.description: Also scrape official review RSS for each app (up to 10 pages / ~500 most recent reviews per app).

maxApps.title: Max apps
maxApps.description: Cap on unique apps collected from search, charts and lookups.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Cap on reviews pulled for each app when reviews are enabled. Official RSS stops at about 500.

maxItems.title: Max results in total
maxItems.description: Hard cap on billed dataset items (apps + reviews) in this run.
